info.name: Sanad App — Library
info.description: Authenticated family-facing Library reads and interactions. Only Published content is visible; premium items return metadata with canAccess=false unless the caller's family subscription grants the PremiumContent benefit (key 8). Use Sanad.local.postman_environment.json and supply a disposable access token.

variable.description: Paste an active library category UUID for categoryId filters.
Paste a Published library content UUID for detail, recommendations, saved/liked/view, and gate checks.

item.name: List active categories
item.description: Authenticated read. Active categories only, ordered by creation time then id. Bare list of {id, arabicName, englishName}.

item.name: List published content
item.description: Published content only. Filters: type=Article|Video, categoryId, search (titles+summaries, both languages), sort=Newest|MostViewed (default Newest; invalid → 400 Cms.Library.InvalidSort), page, pageSize (1–100). Bare list; every item carries isLiked, isSaved, isPremium, canAccess.

item.name: Get content detail
item.description: Published detail with sections (Article) or videoUrl+durationSeconds (Video). Premium content without the PremiumContent benefit returns metadata only: videoUrl=null, sections=[], canAccess=false (200, not an error). Unknown/draft/archived → 404 Cms.LibraryContent.NotPublished.

item.name: Get recommendations
item.description: Deterministic, no ML. Seed precedence contentId > categoryId; same-category newest first excluding the seed, then top-viewed fallback (viewCount desc, recency, id). Same list item shape as the feed, including canAccess.

item.name: List saved content
item.description: The caller's saved Published content, newest-saved-first, same item shape as the feed.

item.name: Set saved
item.description: Explicit set, idempotent 204. {"value": true|false}. Only Published content (else 404 Cms.LibraryContent.NotFound).

item.name: Set liked
item.description: Explicit set, idempotent 204; maintains likesCount (never below zero). Only Published content (else 404 Cms.LibraryContent.NotFound).

item.name: Record view
item.description: 204; increments viewCount on every call — the client calls it once per actual open; the server does not deduplicate. Only Published content (else 404 Cms.LibraryContent.NotFound).
